status: eleventh proposal; local disposable checks passed; exact-source native concurrency and full-schema CI pending
implemented: Prototype limits: at most five unresolved reservations per actor across students and ten per student across actors. Reserved and review_required count; registered claims do not.
Exact existing reserved receipts remain idempotent at or above capacity. Changed, held, registered, foreign and inaccessible intents retain generic refusals. No count or foreign receipt is exposed.

A single transaction-scoped global advisory admission lock (824601,11) serializes new claims. READ COMMITTED is required; stronger snapshot modes are refused. Current edit/partner authority is rechecked after the wait.
Bounded count queries use partial indexes. Existing over-limit rows are preserved without resetting, deleting, expiring, releasing or changing their timestamps. No new table or role mutation rights.

local_disposable_sql.skips: Native-only lock/contention cases; not local concurrency proof.

validation.native_ci: pending; seven new contention cases plus existing nineteen
validation.canonical_replay: pending; all eleven proposals installed only after 210 canonical migrations

limits: Proposal only; no live RPC replacement or app caller integration. Numeric defaults require release review before any promotion.

Global admission serialization intentionally favors correctness over throughput. Long caller transactions can block all reservations; contention/timeout UX, throughput and lock ordering with future recovery operations remain review gates. PostgreSQL deadlock/timeout aborts are not successful receipts.
Admission is an unresolved-row bound, not a byte, bandwidth, daily rate, object-store orphan, provider or spending cap. It cannot stop trusted database owners from bypassing the RPC.
Permission checks are fresh after the admission lock wait but do not lock the full permission graph against later changes.

Held claims remain indefinite and can exhaust capacity. Verified recovery, terminal resolution, retention, expiry and safe cleanup authority remain unimplemented; quota denial never authorizes deletion.

Physical Storage API ownership/rollback/in-flight byte behavior and hosted all-role acceptance remain unperformed. App fingerprint does not include these SQL files; proposal hash and exact CI source are separate proof.
